project_context.domain: IT Niche (Web Design, Custom Solutions, Digital Marketing)
project_context.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for minimal corporate
project_context.tech_stack: Pure HTML5, CSS3 (Custom Properties), Vanilla JS
project_context.core_constraints: No images, no humans. Use ONLY inline SVG line-style illustrations and icons. No CSS/JS frameworks (React, Tailwind, Shadcn are strictly forbidden). Single index.html file.

global_rules: Use CSS variables (:root) for all colors, spacing, and typography.
Implement a mobile-first 12-column CSS Grid system (.grid-container, .col-span-x).
Ensure all interactive elements have visible focus states (outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px;).
Use 'Bento' or 'Control Room' grid aesthetics: visible 1px borders, sharp edges or max 4px radius, creating an infographic blueprint feel.

1_navigation.style: Sticky, minimal, high-contrast bottom border (1px solid #e0e0e0)
1_navigation.structure: Flexbox, space-between. Logo left, Nav links center (hidden on mobile), CTA right.

components.style: Text-based, font-weight: 900, tracking-tight, color: black. Accent dot in primary color.
Lato 400, color: text_muted, hover: text_main, transition 0.2s.
Solid black background, white text, hover: bg-primary. data-testid='nav-cta-button'

2_hero.layout: CSS Grid (2 columns on desktop: 7fr / 5fr). Left: Content, Right: Abstract network SVG.
2_hero.typography: H1 extremely large, tight tracking. Subtitle: text_muted, loose line-height.
2_hero.visuals: Right column must feature a bespoke inline SVG representing 'network/connection' using crisp 1px strokes in #000000 and #e57119.

components.style: Background primary, text white, padding md. data-testid='hero-primary-cta'
Outline button, border black, text black, hover background alt. data-testid='hero-secondary-cta'

3_stats_strip.layout: 4-column CSS Grid. border-top and border-bottom (1px solid border_light).
3_stats_strip.style: Infographic data-readout style. Each cell has a right border (except last).
components: Small uppercase labels (Lato Regular, tracking-wide, color: text_muted).

4_services_benefits.style: Cardless aesthetic. 1px solid border, padding-lg, hover: translateY(-5px) & border-primary.

components.title: Web Design
components.icon_suggestion: Monitor/Pen tool (SVG line art, primary color)

5_why_choose_us.layout: Asymmetrical infographic layout. Left: Sticky heading & context. Right: 2x2 grid of trust pillars.
5_why_choose_us.style: Use connecting SVG lines between the 2x2 grid to look like a flowchart/infographic.

6_process_timeline.layout: Horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile.
6_process_timeline.style: A continuous SVG line connecting 5 nodes. Each node is a circle with a number inside. Alternating content top/bottom on desktop.
6_process_timeline.typography: Node numbers in primary color. Step titles in black, bold.

7_contact_info.style: Dual cards representing locations. Background black, text white. Primary color used for icons and hover states.

8_contact_form.layout: Grid-based form layout inside a bordered container. 2 columns for inputs.
8_contact_form.style: Inputs: background transparent, border-bottom 1px solid border_dark, no side/top borders. Focus: border-primary. Minimalist.
8_contact_form.validation: Vanilla JS client-side validation. Show inline error messages (color: error).
8_contact_form.success_state: Vanilla JS Toast notification on successful submission. data-testid='contact-form-submit'

9_cta_banner.style: Background primary, text white. Center aligned. Massive typography.

components.text: Ready to Transform Your Digital Presence?

components.style: Background black, text white, large padding. data-testid='final-cta-button'

10_footer.style: Background alt (#f4f4f4), text muted. Minimal links.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All buttons use a transform: translateY(-2px) and box-shadow addition. Links use an underline expansion (background-size transition).
interactions_and_motion.scroll_animations: Use IntersectionObserver in Vanilla JS to add an 'is-visible' class, triggering CSS opacity/transform fade-ins for infographic elements.
interactions_and_motion.form_validation: On invalid input, shake animation (CSS keyframes) and red bottom-border.

svg_guidelines.instruction: DO NOT use external image URLs. Generate inline SVGs directly in the HTML file.
svg_guidelines.style: Stroke-width: 1.5px or 2px. Fill: none. Colors: currentColor or var(--color-primary).
svg_guidelines.sources: Use path data resembling lucide/phosphor icons for geometric, clean, modern tech aesthetics.

critical_tech_rules: DO NOT use React, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn, or any external frameworks.
Output EVERYTHING in a single `index.html` file.
Place all CSS inside a <style> tag in the head.
Place all JavaScript inside a <script> tag before the closing body tag.
Define all colors, typography, and spacing as CSS custom properties (:root).
Embed all icons as tags or placeholder images.
Apply exact data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and forms for testing.
instructions_to_main_agent.design_translation: Convert the 'infographic-style' requirement into structural CSS lines using borders, grid gaps, and connected SVG paths between sections. Maintain extremely generous whitespace (padding: 8rem 0) between major sections.
